entries.title: I Chronicles 20:1
segments:
CHAP. XX. 
 
  Rabbah is taken, ver. 1-3.   The Philistine giants are slain, ver. 4-8.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:2
segments: V. 2. To weigh a talent-Or, to be worth a talent, that is, five thousand four hundred and seventy five pounds.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:8
segments: V. 8. They fell, &c -We need not fear great men against us, while we have the great God for us.
